verdict.rationale: Gide's own materials touch on founder equity: the Executives & Management Packages practice says it supports company founders, and it lists an insight on BSPCE (French founder-warrant) taxation under the 2026 finance law, which is a local founder-equity tax mechanic. Nothing in the pack covers vesting schedules, an 83(b)-style election, or splits among co-founders. Missing for 10: founder vesting schedule content, 83(b)/local-equivalent election guidance, co-founder equity split guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
